At each of 4 outdoor sites, the students assembled the
apparatus shown in Figure 2. First, they attached a long
piece of tubing to a stand so that one end of the tubing was
1.5 m above the ground. Then, they placed the other end of
the tubing into one hole of a 2-holed stopper. Next, they
placed one end of a shorter piece of tubing into the second
hole of the 2-holed stopper and attached the other end of
the shorter tubing to a vacuum pump.
